{"version":"2b1","blocks":[{"type":"text","text":"Compare Native Hybrid, Tauri, and Electron by three criteria: native experience, lightweight runtime, and delivery efficiency. Adjust weights to see how rankings change. Scores are synthetic and normalized by the sum of weights. Rankings show descending order by weighted score. If all weights are zero, no ranking is shown."},{"type":"ui","source":"root = Stack([weights,nativeHybridScore,tauriScore,electronScore,ranking])

// Input weights for criteria
$w_native = 40
$w_light = 25
$w_delivery = 35

weights = Stack([
  Control("Native Experience Weight",0,100,[], $w_native),
  Control("Lightweight Runtime Weight",0,100,[], $w_light),
  Control("Delivery Efficiency Weight",0,100,[], $w_delivery)
])

// Scores for each platform (native experience, lightweight runtime, delivery efficiency)
nativeHybridRaw = [9,8,7]
tauriRaw = [7,8,8]
electronRaw = [6,4,10]

// Sum of weights
weightSum = $w_native + $w_light + $w_delivery

// Normalized weights or zero if sum zero
nw_native = weightSum == 0 ? 0 : $w_native / weightSum
nw_light = weightSum == 0 ? 0 : $w_light / weightSum
nw_delivery = weightSum == 0 ? 0 : $w_delivery / weightSum

// Weighted scores
nh_score = nativeHybridRaw[0]*nw_native + nativeHybridRaw[1]*nw_light + nativeHybridRaw[2]*nw_delivery
tauri_score = tauriRaw[0]*nw_native + tauriRaw[1]*nw_light + tauriRaw[2]*nw_delivery
electron_score = electronRaw[0]*nw_native + electronRaw[1]*nw_light + electronRaw[2]*nw_delivery

nativeHybridScore = Metric("Native Hybrid Score", nh_score)
tauriScore = Metric("Tauri Score", tauri_score)
electronScore = Metric("Electron Score", electron_score)

// Prepare ranking list
rankingList = weightSum == 0 ? [] : [
  {label: "Native Hybrid", score: nh_score},
  {label: "Tauri", score: tauri_score},
  {label: "Electron", score: electron_score}
]

// Sort descending by score
sortedRanking = weightSum == 0 ? [] : @Sort(rankingList, "score", "desc")

// Format ranking text or show no ranking
rankingText = weightSum == 0 ? "No ranking: all weights are zero." : "Ranking (descending):\n" + 
  sortedRanking[0].label + ": " + sortedRanking[0].score + "\n" +
  sortedRanking[1].label + ": " + sortedRanking[1].score + "\n" +
  sortedRanking[2].label + ": " + sortedRanking[2].score

ranking = Text(rankingText)","state":[{"name":"w_native","value":40},{"name":"w_light","value":25},{"name":"w_delivery","value":35}]}]}
